helpers.name: steps_to_effect__steps_effect
helpers.strategy: Prove forall sg p waiting before, semaphore_pending_nodes p before (map sched_link_node waiting) -> os_inv sg before |-- “ (forall final, semaphore_resume_all_steps p waiting before final -> semaphore_resume_all_effect p waiting before final) ”. Induct over waiting and steps with a prefix/suffix invariant. Show later distinct task lookups equal original-map lookups; per-step updates change only stat/exstatus. Compose ready insertions into resume_all_ready by proving their insensitivity to earlier stat/exstatus map updates. Show repeated delay cancellation equals the batch selected-delay filter/find, using initial active-node uniqueness and active/inactive disjointness, including zero, inactive and repeated delay pointer cases. Compose semaphore_set_pending and every preserved global component, then extensionality gives the batch state. Nil is final=before. Prove required algebraic facts within this helper family without assuming the obligation Definition or importing sibling output.
